children: RNS Number : 8836T  Manolete Partners PLC  08 September 2026

Manolete (AIM:MANO), the UK's leading insolvency claims financing company, announces that, at its Annual General Meeting held earlier today, all resolutions were duly passed.  A summary of the votes submitted by proxy before the meeting will be provided on the Company's website.
